text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Bochum stood at 9.58 €/m², up 4.5 % year‑on‑year and 24.9 % over the past five years. The 25th‑percentile was 8.12 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 10.79 €/m², placing the city 31st of the 37 most expensive German markets.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.2 % and an average of 31 days on market; 20 % of listings are let within a week. Asking rents are 53 % above the 2022 existing rent of 6.25 €/m², while a 60 m² apartment costs about 575 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 13.9 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.09 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 9.8 €/m² and 10.3 €/m², implying a 5.3 % increase.
